title: The Salary Band Secret Costing You $14,000
hook: Your boss already knows the exact max they'd pay you — and they're legally allowed to hide that number while you stay thousands below it.
angle: Most employers use salary bands with 40-80% spreads between floor and ceiling. 60% of workers are paid below the midpoint. Pay-transparent states show workers earn $14K more on average. Most workers don't even know salary bands exist — let alone that they can ask for them.
audience: Full-time employees who have never asked about or been shown their salary band — especially those who've accepted an offer without negotiating using range data
key_numbers: 60% of workers are paid below their salary band midpoint
Salary bands span 40-80% from floor to ceiling
Workers in pay-transparent states earn $14K more on average
10 states now require salary ranges in job postings
$5,500+ more per year for workers who negotiate using band data
